description: Read-only. The context pack to read before starting work on this project (like `pk context`): purpose and the owner's words, direction, plan, relevant work, recent changes, open notes, with numbered sources. Whole project by default; give `work` for one work item or area.

cwd.description: A folder inside the project. Default: the folder the server was started in.

kind.description: What the pack is for. Default: Implement.

port.description: Workbench port. Default: the one in ProjectKeeper's settings (4870).

project.description: Project id (`pk projects` lists them). Default: the project containing cwd.

purpose.description: Start (default for the project) or Work (default with work).

recipient.description: Who reads it: "Incoming agent" (default) or a role the project recognises.

since.description: Time of your last pack; gives only what changed since.

work.description: A work item or area, by id or name. Omit for the whole project.

name: projectkeeper_context
